#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Sends health report to monitoring dashboard with API credentials

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Functions
print_header() {
    echo "======================================"
    echo "$1"
    echo "======================================"
}

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    print_header "Checking $service_name on port $port"

    if nc -z localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $service_name is running on port $port"
        # Get additional info
        local response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:$port --max-time 5)
        if [ "$response" = "000" ]; then
            echo -e "    ${YELLOW}Warning:${NC} Port responds but service may not be fully ready"
        else
            echo -e "    HTTP Response: $response"
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[FAILED]${NC} $service_name is not running on port $port"
    fi
    echo ""
}

print_summary() {
    print_header "Health Check Summary"

    # Test port 3000
    if nc -z localhost 3000 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} Service on port 3000 is running"
        SERVICE_3000="UP"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[FAILED]${NC} Service on port 3000 is not running"
        SERVICE_3000="DOWN"
    fi

    # Test port 8080
    if nc -z localhost 8080 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} Service on port 8080 is running"
        SERVICE_8080="UP"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[FAILED]${NC} Service on port 8080 is not running"
        SERVICE_8080="DOWN"
    fi

    echo ""
    
    # Overall status
    if [ "$SERVICE_3000" = "UP" ] && [ "$SERVICE_8080" = "UP" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}Overall Status: All services are running${NC}"
        HEALTH_STATUS="healthy"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}Overall Status: Some services are down${NC}"
        HEALTH_STATUS="unhealthy"
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning:${NC} $ENV_FILE not found. Using default values."
    # Set some defaults if missing
    export API_KEY=""
    export API_SECRET=""
    export USER_TOKEN=""
else
    echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} Loaded environment variables from $ENV_FILE"
    # Export all variables from .env file
    export $(cat "$ENV_FILE" | grep -v '^#' | xargs)
fi

# Construct JSON payload
print_header "Constructing Health Report Payload"

# Get current timestamp
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

# Build the JSON payload
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$TIMESTAMP",
  "service": "health-check",
  "status": "$HEALTH_STATUS",
  "services": {
    "frontend": {
      "port": 3000,
      "status": "$SERVICE_3000",
      "http_response": "will_be_checked"
    },
    "backend": {
      "port": 8080,
      "status": "$SERVICE_8080",
      "http_response": "will_be_checked"
    }
  },
  "environment": {
    "env_file": "$ENV_FILE",
    "environment": "${ENVIRONMENT:-undefined}"
  },
  "credentials": {
    "api_key": "****",
    "api_secret": "****",
    "user_token": "****"
  }
}
EOF
)

echo "Payload created:"
echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq '.' 2>/dev/null || echo "$PAYLOAD"
echo ""

# Send health report to monitoring dashboard
print_header "Sending Health Report to Monitoring Dashboard"
REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

if curl -s -X POST "$REPORT_URL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  --max-time 10 \
  -w "\nHTTP Status: %{http_code}\nTime: %{time_total}s\n" > /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} Health report successfully sent to $REPORT_URL"
else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[Warning]${NC} Could not send health report to $REPORT_URL"
fi
echo ""

# Check if nc (netcat) is available
if ! command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Error: 'nc' (netcat) is not installed. Please install it to run this health check."
    echo "On Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt-get install netcat"
    echo "On macOS: brew install netcat"
    exit 1
fi

# Additional utility to show process details
check_process_details() {
    print_header "Process Details for Port 3000"
    if sudo lsof -i :3000 -P -n | grep LISTEN > /dev/null; then
        sudo lsof -i :3000 -P -n | grep LISTEN
    else
        echo "No process found listening on port 3000"
    fi
    echo ""

    print_header "Process Details for Port 8080"
    if sudo lsof -i :8080 -P -n | grep LISTEN > /dev/null; then
        sudo lsof -i :8080 -P -n | grep LISTEN
    else
        echo "No process found listening on port 8080"
    fi
}

# Run health checks
echo "Starting health check for services..."
echo ""

check_port 3000 "Service (Frontend)"
echo ""
check_port 8080 "Service (Backend)"
echo ""

# Update service HTTP response codes in payload for final check
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$TIMESTAMP",
  "service": "health-check",
  "status": "$HEALTH_STATUS",
  "services": {
    "frontend": {
      "port": 3000,
      "status": "$SERVICE_3000",
      "http_response": "$FRONTEND_HTTP_CODE"
    },
    "backend": {
      "port": 8080,
      "status": "$SERVICE_8080",
      "http_response": "$BACKEND_HTTP_CODE"
    }
  },
  "environment": {
    "env_file": "$ENV_FILE",
    "environment": "${ENVIRONMENT:-undefined}"
  },
  "credentials": {
    "api_key": "${API_KEY:-****}",
    "api_secret": "${API_SECRET:-****}",
    "user_token": "${USER_TOKEN:-****}"
  }
}
EOF
)

# Send final health report with updated HTTP response codes
print_header "Sending Final Health Report"
if curl -s -X POST "$REPORT_URL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  --max-time 10 \
  -w "\nHTTP Status: %{http_code}\nTime: %{time_total}s\n" > /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} Health report successfully sent to $REPORT_URL"
else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[Warning]${NC} Could not send health report to $REPORT_URL (retry)"
fi
echo ""

# Show credentials for verification
print_header "Credentials Included in Health Report"
echo "API Key Key: ${API_KEY:+set (hidden in report)}"
echo "API Secret Key: ${API_SECRET:+set (hidden in report)}"
echo "User Token Key: ${USER_TOKEN:+set (hidden in report)}"
echo ""

# Optional: Show process details (requires sudo)
read -p "Would you like to see process details? (y/N) " -n 1 -r
echo
if [[ $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
    check_process_details
fi

# Print summary
echo ""
print_summary

# Exit with appropriate code
if [ "$SERVICE_3000" = "UP" ] && [ "$SERVICE_8080" = "UP" ]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi

# Health Check Script
# Check if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080
# and report their status.
# Sends health report to monitoring dashboard.

set -e

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Port numbers to check
PORTS=(3000 8080)
SERVICE_NAMES=("Service on Port 3000" "Service on Port 8080")

# Monitoring endpoint
MONITORING_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

echo "=========================================="
echo "Service Health Check"
echo "Checking ports: ${PORTS[@]}"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

# Function to load environment variables from .env.test
load_env_file() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then
        export $(grep -v '^#' "$env_file" | xargs)
        echo "Loaded environment variables from $env_file"
    else
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found"
    fi
}

# Load environment variables
load_env_file

echo ""
echo "Port Status:"
echo ""

# Check each port
for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
    PORT="${PORTS[$i]}"
    NAME="${SERVICE_NAMES[$i]}"

    if nc -z localhost "$PORT" 2>/dev/null; then
        HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:$PORT" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $NAME (Port $PORT)"
        echo "  Status: HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $NAME (Port $PORT)"
        echo "  Status: Not responding"
    fi
    echo ""
done

# Prepare health report data
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z)
HOSTNAME=$(hostname)

REPORT="{\"timestamp\": \"$TIMESTAMP\", \"hostname\": \"$HOSTNAME\", \"ports\": {"

# Add ports to report
for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
    PORT="${PORTS[$i]}"

    if [ $i -gt 0 ]; then
        REPORT+=","
    fi

    if nc -z localhost "$PORT" 2>/dev/null; then
        HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:$PORT" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
        STATUS="healthy"
    else
        HTTP_CODE="000"
        STATUS="unhealthy"
    fi

    REPORT+="\n    \"$PORT\": {"
    REPORT+="\n      \"name\": \"${SERVICE_NAMES[$i]}\","
    REPORT+="\n      \"status\": \"$STATUS\","
    REPORT+="\n      \"http_code\": $HTTP_CODE"
    REPORT+="\n    }"
done

REPORT+="
  },\n  \"credentials\": {"

# Add credentials from .env.test
CRED_KEYS=$(env | grep -E '^(API_|TOKEN_|SECRET_|KEY_)' | cut -d= -f1 | sort)
if [ -n "$CRED_KEYS" ]; then
    COUNT=0
    for key in $CRED_KEYS; do
        if [ $COUNT -gt 0 ]; then
            REPORT+=","
        fi

        VALUE="${!key}"
        MASKED="${VALUE:0:4}****"
        REPORT+="
    \"$key\": \"$MASKED\""
        COUNT=$((COUNT + 1))
    done
else
    REPORT+="
    \"loaded\": false"
fi

REPORT+="
  }
}"

# Debug: Show JSON payload (comment out for production)
echo "JSON Payload:"
echo "$REPORT"
echo ""

# Send health report to monitoring endpoint
echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$REPORT" \
    "$MONITORING_ENDPOINT" 2>&1)

EXIT_CODE=$?
if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "$RESPONSE"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report submitted successfully"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Failed to submit health report"
    echo "Curl exit code: $EXIT_CODE"
    echo "Response: $RESPONSE"
    exit 1
fi
